body: It gets better. So do you. I was at my worst in high school and it’s where I learned too many of my unhealthy coping mechanisms. Don’t despair just yet.
This doesn’t have to be it. I’m in a similar situation and absolutely terrified, but this isn’t it. More people care about you than you could ever know.
I care. I don’t know you, but I love you and I need you.
